verdict.rationale: Raygun ships its own client providers/SDKs. Community users describe open-source .NET providers and WinRT support, and the changelog records SDK-level work such as the .NET SendInBackground queueing change and SDK deprecations. The pack has no first-party SDK catalog or reference docs, though. The OpenAPI spec is a REST API rather than an SDK, so it gets no credit here. Missing for 10: a documented list of official SDKs per language, SDK installation/reference documentation, and evidence of SDK suitability for AI-native/agent workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
